title: Guidewire Developer
summary: Guidewire developers configure and extend Guidewire's insurance software (PolicyCenter for policies, ClaimCenter for claims, BillingCenter for billing) for property and casualty insurers. They sit in insurance IT teams at services firms or insurers, working from business analysts' stories and writing code in Gosu, Guidewire's Java-like language.
dailyDuties: Configure product model, entities and typelists for new coverages
Write Gosu rules and enhancements for validation and rating
Build PCF screens and wizards from user stories
Build or fix integrations through plugins, messaging and web services
Debug defects with SQL queries and server logs
Join stand-ups and demos with onshore insurance teams

skills.expectation: Configure PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter or BillingCenter: product model, entities, typelists, PCF screens and rules
Write Gosu rules, enhancements and classes in Guidewire Studio
Build or support integrations through plugins, messaging and batch processes
Read and write Java, since Gosu runs on the JVM and integrations often use Java
Know the P&C policy, claims and billing lifecycle the screens and rules serve
Build and call REST web services between Guidewire and other systems
Query the application database to trace data and debug issues
Explain changes to business analysts and onshore teams, often across US or UK hours
Work with SOAP services and XML payloads in older integrations
Deploy and support InsuranceSuite on Guidewire Cloud
Use Git branches and pull requests for configuration changes
Write GUnit tests for rules and classes
Use build pipelines for Guidewire deployments
Help move policy or claims data from legacy systems
Work in Scrum sprints with onshore product owners
